Create an original composition and character, no copying of the reference layout. Subject: a cheerful young adult male with fluffy curly solid-black hair, leaning over an oversized open laptop and actively typing code with both hands, a pencil tucked above his ear. The laptop screen angles slightly toward viewer with a simple black </> symbol and 3 short code lines, clearly identifiable as coding. Half-body compact square composition designed to remain readable at thumbnail sizes; character and laptop form one strong silhouette; ample transparent margin, no cropped anatomy, no separate floating decoration. Use only black #141414, opaque white, and ONE dominant accent violet #7B69C9, allowed lighter tonal variations of this violet only. Violet shirt and a few laptop details; no blush or pink or blue. Flat vector-like raster editorial illustration, no gradients, no shading, no 3D rendering, no texture, no background rectangle or colored tile. Transparent exterior; retain opaque white faces and screen. No labels, no words, no brand logos, no watermarks. Original professional friendly educational illustration, refined black linework.
